_about: How each car drives (D98). A car takes the first entry whose 'models' match its model file's name (a part of it is enough), else 'default'. mass kg; power: the engine's pull in newtons (all driven wheels together); top_kmh on roads (off road a little over half); grip front/rear: tyre friction, about the g of cornering (1.4 slides, 2 grips hard; over ~2.5 a tall car tips without the anti-roll helper); drive: front, rear or all; steer: the wheels' lock at parking speed, radians; brakes: brake torque per wheel; suspension: spring stiffness, and damping [compression, rebound]; com_y: the centre of mass moved up (+) or down (-) from just above the sills, m; antiroll: the arcade anti-roll strength (1 normal, 0 off); engine: where it sits (front, rear), for the lids (D96); tank: litres of petrol; consumption: litres per 100 km at a steady cruise (more with your foot down, a little while idling; the sandbox's 'Petrol use' scales it, D123); boot: kilograms the boot and back seat hold together (D125).
